definition: Wetware is a term drawn from the computer-related idea of hardware or software, but applied to biological life forms..
details: Wetware is a term drawn from the computer-related idea of hardware or software, but applied to biological life forms.
story: Picture an engineer at a cluttered workbench, turning a clever idea over in their hands until it finally clicks. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. A small key that opens a much bigger door. It is one of those ideas that feels obvious only after someone shows it to you. That is Wetware (brain) — a small key that opens a big door.
